title: October CPI tops forecasts, cementing December Fed rate hike
summary: The U.S. consumer price index rose 0.4% in October, with core CPI up 0.3%, both beating expectations. CME FedWatch put odds of a December 50 bp hike at 13.6% after the report; a quarter-point move is widely seen as near-certain. The Fed's next rate decision is December 9.
why: 美联储12月加息路径基本锁定，对整体权益市场与期权隐含波动率有方向性影响；持有短期看涨期权头寸须留意利率上行压力；sell put策略中美元计价资产需考虑利率对估值的抑制效应。

title: China's goods surplus tops $1 trillion for a second year as AI-driven exports surge 35%
summary: China's October exports rose 35.2% year on year. Semiconductor exports jumped 111% in dollar terms in the first ten months. The cumulative January-October trade surplus exceeded $1 trillion, the fastest pace on record. October monthly surplus was $105.3 billion, below September's $133.5 billion as imports picked up.
why: AI硬件出口激增强化科技供应链周期，利好港A股AI硬件与半导体标的；累计顺差创纪录将加剧中美贸易摩擦，可能在APEC会议周边触发政策表态，注意出口管制与关税政策风险。

title: Jensen Huang's reported ties to Chinese spy further complicate Nvidia's China problem; Congress demands scrutiny
summary: CNBC reports Congressional Democrats are intensifying scrutiny of Nvidia after reports linking CEO Jensen Huang to an alleged Chinese intelligence operative. Democrats, who took control of Congress, plan investigations and proposals on chip export oversight. Nvidia said H200 shipments to China were less than 1% of data center revenue in the quarter ended July. The board launched an independent probe.
why: NVDA本周大幅下跌，出口管制收紧风险上升；AI芯片供应链（SK海力士、美光）受波及；短期卖出NVDA看跌期权需特别注意尾部风险，建议等待尘埃落定后再布局。

title: Morgan Stanley calls China internet a structural slow-growth sector, cuts Meituan to Equal Weight (HK$90) and PDD to Equal Weight
summary: Morgan Stanley downgraded Meituan (3690.HK) from Overweight to Equal Weight, cutting its target from HK$110 to HK$90. It simultaneously downgraded PDD Holdings. The bank projects China platform GMV to grow at only 3.2% CAGR 2026-2030, arguing consolidation is unlikely as cash-rich platforms defend core markets while expanding into rivals' territory. Meituan fell approximately 6.5% on the session.
why: 摩根士丹利将中国互联网电商定性为结构性低增长，对美团和拼多多卖出期权(sell put)策略构成负面背景：股价下行风险加剧，期权定价已进入较高隐含波动率区间；11月下旬两家均有财报，可等待财报后确认预期底部。当日重大头条以美国宏观和英伟达为主，中国互联网结构性调整是第4条大盘级信号。

title: Alibaba's chip unit T-Head gets HKEX go-ahead for independent listing, targeting 2027 IPO
summary: SCMP reports the Hong Kong Stock Exchange confirmed Alibaba may proceed with spinning off and independently listing its AI chip unit T-Head. T-Head filed a confidential A1 listing application on September 11, 2026, targeting a main board listing via global offering, aiming to raise roughly US$2-3 billion in 2027. Alibaba has not set a final timetable or offering size.
why: T-Head若成功上市将打通阿里巴巴AI芯片自主化的资产价值，是中国半导体自主可控的里程碑事件；对9988/BABA持有方而言是资产估值解锁信号；11月19日Q3财报前，这是重要的正面催化剂。
